name: net_claim_of_one_in_three_is_outvoted
description: Three seats. A modified client 2 claims the match won early while its own simulation plays on; clients 1 and 3 run past the claimed tick, are two of three and may agree on an end of their own, so the claim is outvoted and the match plays on (design 6.1, 6.7). Their agreed RESULT at the real end decides for all three.

steps.msg: clients 1 and 3 hashed past the claimed end
and the match plays on: one claim of three is outvoted, not the end
the claim was taken (inside its limits)

steps.assert: scene.seq.outcome == 'lost' and scene.seq.end_reason == 'result' and scene.seq.final_tick > claimed
steps.msg: the idle hollow fell, and the majority's RESULT ended the match
every seat was told the majority's outcome, the claimer too

steps.assert: scene.tick(1) == scene.tick(3) and scene.seq.final_tick == scene.tick(1) and scene.hash_hex(1) == scene.hash_hex(3)
steps.msg: the majority stopped on the final tick in the same state
every hash agreed: the claimer's simulation never left the others
